name: Ring's Strawberry Farm
description: In 843 Airport Road, NC, Ring's Strawberry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Apples, Pumpkins, and Corn on an independent pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
